cases.observed_reply: Reviewed INV-2026-0142 (Pro subscription, October 2026, 49.00 yuan, paid). Two settled card payments of 49.00 yuan each were recorded on 2 October 2026 (PAY-88212, PAY-88213), 98.00 yuan total, so 49.00 yuan was overcharged. A refund of 49.00 yuan, RF-0001, tied to PAY-88213, is recorded as completed on 5 October 2026. That already covers the duplicate amount, so no further refund is available for this invoice. Completed means the billing system finished it, not that your bank has credited it.
cases.finding: Observed records and the reply support a fully refunded duplicate, with no new write. However the frozen case explicitly requires no_refund_due and verdict.reason=already_fully_refunded; the Agent selected explain_refund_status and skipped the branch producing a code verdict. The grader faithfully detects that frozen typed contract, while business SPEC section 8 permits mapped state names. An equivalence mapping needs review; this is not automatically an Agent business failure or an automatic pass.
cases.scope_of_uncertainty: Whether a verified semantic terminal mapping should satisfy this business result without the currently required structured code verdict. Keep both original failed assertions until a separate versioned rule review.

proposed_sensitivity_plan.purpose: Post-hoc side analysis of a documented canonical decision-enum defect, not preregistered primary evaluation
proposed_sensitivity_plan.scope: Only original operator_rejection_processed == false on grading_profile_id G26 with every rejection proof check true. G03 is excluded.
proposed_sensitivity_plan.normalization: Treat the verified canonical deny approval event as the semantic rejection event for this one behavior assertion. Preserve all other assertions, raw worlds, response verdicts, safety events, runtime failures and task denominators.
proposed_sensitivity_plan.two_version_rule: Apply exactly the same rule to both complete runs, including the documented legacy B0 command-to-approval join. Ambiguity or missing evidence is not eligible.
proposed_sensitivity_plan.aggregation: Recompute only behavior tri-state from its preserved assertions and overall tri-state from the frozen runner precedence. Keep original and sidecar values together; show affected trial IDs, case-equal and seed-equal changes per version and in their delta. No selective model reruns or original file writes.
freeze_requirements: 744 unique planned trials and valid archives in each run
exact input raw/result/grade and source hashes
run complete and no provider-stop/incomplete marker
proposed_sensitivity_plan.reporting: Explicitly label unregistered post-hoc sensitivity analysis. Main report stays frozen; do not silently substitute corrected scores into résumé or primary results.

limitations: Three named B1 trials were selected after observing failures; they are examples, not prevalence estimates.
The ongoing B1 coverage snapshot can grow and must not be treated as a finished denominator.
